items.title: Jon Hendricks — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Buddy Rich never understood that a drummer should know how to read music.

ctx.x: You must have a heck of an archive.

I do. I do. But I just didn’t know that you didn’t do those things or that they couldn’t be done. Most of what I do, I do because I didn’t know you couldn’t do it. I think that’s a very valuable piece of information, because Erroll Garner didn’t know that you had to learn to read and study to play the piano. He just climbed up on the piano and played the piano.
